_what: The fetched bibliographic record for PMID 39048711 — the paper behind GEO GSE243553, the pooled single-cell ATAC screen that carries four NR4A3 fusions. It exists because reference 5a of nr4a3-fusion-transcriptional-output.md needs an author list, title, journal, volume and page range, and NO tracked file in this repository held those fields: lit-targets-nr4a3-cistrome.json holds the IDENTIFIERS, and the payload holding the fields sits on branch `literature-cache`, which is not `main`. An artifact that lives only on a branch is a fact that can be lost (CLAUDE.md §7), so the fields are landed here.
_what_this_is_not: NOT a verification of the paper's contents. It records what one API returned on one date. Every scientific figure attributed to this paper in §3.11 of the manuscript is QUOTED from the paper's own text and has not been re-derived by this repository; the deposit's barcode-to-variant association files have never been opened here.

record.title: Large-scale discovery of chromatin dysregulation induced by oncofusions and other protein-coding variants.
record.authorString: Frenkel M, Corban JE, Hujoel MLA, Morris Z, Raman S.

_deposit.note: The GEO series for this paper. Its own characterisation — assay, cell line, sample accessions, library membership and the four NR4A3 arms — has ONE home and is not restated here: research/manuscripts/nr4a3-cistrome-search-2026-08-08.md section 3.
_deposit.⚠_the_constraint_that_travels_with_it: Chromatin ACCESSIBILITY in HEK293T from an ectopically expressed construct. It is not occupancy, and it is not EMC chromatin. It may never be cited as an NR4A3-fusion cistrome, and no gene may be called fusion-driven from it.
